subject: Contract amendment: activation & billing flow for AWS Marketplace listing
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: CloudCorp Procurement <procurement@cloudcorp.com>; Betsy Cohen <betsy@cloudcorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>; Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract amendment: activation & billing flow for AWS Marketplace listing

Hi Betsy / CloudCorp team,

Thanks again for moving quickly here. Per our conversation this week, we've prepared a short amendment that captures:
- the SaaS activation gating (how and when CloudCorp customers are considered \"active\" for AWS Marketplace metering),
- the mapping between CloudCorp SKUs and AWS entitlement IDs, and
- a 60-day invoicing lag carve-out while we reconcile first-month usage.

Attached: SaaS_amendment_v2.docx — highlights in the first page for quick review.

As a summary of open items before DocuSign:
1) Confirmation that CloudCorp will accept 1% tolerance for meter rounding during the first billing cycle (we can tighten after month 2).
2) Which internal CloudCorp team will provide the sample usage CSV (columns: account_id, sku, timestamp, usage_units) — we need one week of data to validate entitlement mapping.
3) PO or billing contact for the initial activation invoice (we've noted Betsy but put procurement by default).

Next steps I propose: short 30-min sync with CloudCorp procurement + your legal (if needed) + AWS partner (Jenna) so we can align on fulfillment handoff and any required SLA exception for the first billing run. Are you available Mon/Tue next week?

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Lead, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Can we include Jenna from AWS on the sync? AWS will want to confirm fulfillment flow on their side.

Betsy

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Contract amendment: activation & billing flow for AWS Marketplace listing

Forwarding Betsy's questions and adding operational notes so we have clear ownership: 

On Fri, Jul 30, 2027 at 10:05 AM Betsy Cohen <betsy@cloudcorp.com> wrote:
> Marcus — thanks for sending this over. A few quick notes after an internal read: 
> - Legal flagged the 60-day invoicing lag; they'll accept it for launch but asked us to include a clause to revisit after 90 days.
> - Procurement would like the PO and payment terms locked prior to signing; I've attached our PO stub.
> - Question on the entitlement mapping: will Redwood provide a one-time mapping table and then provide webhook callbacks for live entitlement updates, or do we need to push all usage rows into your ingestion API?

Operational proposal from Redwood (short):
- Entitlement mapping: Redwood will produce a one-time mapping CSV that maps CloudCorp SKU -> AWS entitlement_id and a canonical account_id. That mapping is the source of truth for the first 30 days.
- Ingestion: CloudCorp can push daily usage files to our secured S3 endpoint (signed URL) OR push via our ingestion API (preferred for automation). We will accept both.
- Webhooks: Redwood will provide a webhook for entitlement-change notifications (e.g., sku deprecations or account migrations). Webhooks will be optional and documented.
- Reconciliation: For month 0 and month 1 we propose manual reconciliation with weekly exports between teams; after month 1 we switch to automated reconciliation and finalize the tolerance levels.

Action items I suggest:
- Marcus: schedule the 30-minute cross-org sync including AWS (Jenna) and CloudCorp Legal.
- Naomi: confirm whether Redwood's fulfillment team needs any special AWS Marketplace seller role access or just the entitlement mapping.
- Betsy: if procurement can send PO terms we can slot that into the amendment prior to DocuSign.

Thanks — I'll be on the sync and can help with the ingestion checklist.

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Betsy Cohen <betsy@cloudcorp.com>; CloudCorp Procurement <procurement@cloudcorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>; Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>; Jenna Liu <jenna.liu@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract amendment: activation & billing flow for AWS Marketplace listing

Thanks everyone — good alignment so far. Quick answers and plan: 

1) Legal + invoicing cadence: happy to include a 90-day review clause. We'll add a sentence to that effect and re-issue the amendment.

2) PO / payment terms: Betsy — received your PO stub. If procurement sends the final net-30 terms we will populate the amendment and route to DocuSign.

3) Entitlement & ingestion flow (ops): Redwood will provide the one-time mapping CSV (we'll own that work end-to-end). For ingestion we recommend the ingestion API for automated daily pushes; we'll accept signed S3 uploads as fallback. Webhooks will be available for entitlement-change notifications. See attached: saaS_activation_checklist.xlsx — this lists the minimal sample row we need from CloudCorp to validate mapping.

4) AWS involvement: Jenna, can you confirm whether AWS Marketplace will require Redwood to be assigned the contract fulfillment role in the AWS Seller Console, or is the mapping + usage push sufficient? We want to avoid role request delays during activation.

Proposed sync: Wed Aug 4 at 10:00 AM PT — 30 minutes. Agenda: (1) finalize PO/payment clause, (2) operational handoff and sample payload, (3) AWS fulfillment role questions.

DocuSign: I will post the updated amendment to the linked DocuSign envelope once language is updated: https://docusign.net/embedded/sign/ABCDEFG12345

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Lead, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
